description: This file defines the InstallationInstanceAPI class which extends an abstract controller for handling REST API requests related to installation instances within the OrangeHRM system. It handles POST requests to set up system configuration during installation.

classes.name: InstallationInstanceAPI
classes.description: Controller class handling API requests related to installation instances, specifically the handling of POST requests to configure the system during setup.

methods.name: handlePost
methods.description: Handles the POST request to initialize system configuration during the installation process by invoking AppSetupUtility.
